name: blend_book

operators.name: draw
operators.precondition: ?vat is a Vat, ?blend is a Blend, ?gallons is an integer of at least 1, ?blend.bottled is false, ?vat.closed is false, ?vat.gallons is at least ?gallons, the world contains fewer than 12 objects, and if ?blend.single_varietal is true and any Draw already points into ?blend then ?vat.varietal equals the varietal of every Vat already drawn into ?blend.
operators.effect: Create a new Draw whose ticket is the next unused positive integer in this episode and whose gallons is ?gallons; set from_vat of that Draw to ?vat and into_blend of that Draw to ?blend; subtract ?gallons from ?vat.gallons. New Draw ids are draw-1, draw-2, ... in creation order since the last reset and are not reused after return_draw.

operators.name: return_draw
operators.precondition: ?draw is a Draw and the Blend at into_blend of ?draw is not bottled.
operators.effect: Add ?draw.gallons back to the Vat at from_vat of ?draw; remove from_vat and into_blend for ?draw; delete ?draw.

operators.name: close_vat
operators.precondition: ?vat is a Vat and ?vat.closed is false.

operators.name: open_vat
operators.precondition: ?vat is a Vat and ?vat.closed is true.

operators.name: bottle
operators.precondition: ?blend is a Blend, ?blend.bottled is false, at least one Draw has into_blend ?blend, and the sum of gallons on those Draws is at least 2.

operators.name: disgorge
operators.precondition: ?blend is a Blend and ?blend.bottled is true.

notes: A cellar clerk's blend book. Vats are sources; Blends are targets; a Draw is a link object recording how many gallons moved from one vat into one blend (many Draws may share a vat or a blend). All attributes are rendered, including Draw.ticket as 'Ticket N'. Remaining vat gallons change when drawing and returning. Committed gallons on a blend row are derived from its Draws, not stored. The page is a ledger: a draw ticket with three selects (vat, blend, gallons 1-4), a vat table, a blend table, and a draw table. POST /api/do with JSON {op, args} is the page's action endpoint; argument keys in that JSON and in the evaluator log use the '?' names from the operator params.
